bayts.text: And drive out the others (all but You) from my heart, and bring the lights into it, O my Guide.
And be my help in what sets right, and spare me all that makes foul.
And show me the subtleties of the secrets of Your beneficial knowledge and of the lights.
And grant me certainty and gnosis, (spiritual) taste, forgiveness and good pleasure,
and steadfastness in worship, unveiling, direct vision and felicity.
And set right the community of the best of Messengers, and relieve them all, O Most High (Al-ʿAlī).
And have mercy, bless, then grant well-being to them all, and save them, be gentle with them and forgive them.
And make me, O Lord, among the greatest of servants with You, in fortune and share, in perpetuity.
And make all my movements for You, and my stillnesses obedience, by Your grace.
And make my life and my death within the traditions, the obligatory and the recommended, in secret and in public.
And make my death a rest for me from toil, from heartache, from love's anguish and from suffering.
And make all my deeds accepted, until I become an accepted example.
And make my dwelling a blessed dwelling, and make me a wayfarer and a devotee.
I call on You to make it an abode of the fear of Allah, of knowledge and religion, and an abode of ascent,
a garden (janna) for the aspiring wayfarer (murīd) and a shield (junna) against the rending rebel (marīd),
a place of benefit for every Muslim guide, and a place of defence against every criminal aggressor,
a pilgrimage for whoever is clothed in weakness, and a screen against the opponent, tomorrow,
a place of seeking obedience to the Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), and a place of flight from obedience to the accursed (ar-Rajīm),
a path for the ways of following (the Sunna), and a place of leaving the ways of innovation,
a dwelling to draw every good, and a dwelling to repel every harm,
a cause for the opening of the good of the Unseen, and a cause for repelling the harm of defect.
And make its land a land of provision and security, of mercy and plenty, at every time.
O Repeller of evils and troubles, through the Chosen repel every evil from my house.
And forgive those who built its lofty building, and forgive him who commanded them in it, all of them.
And (forgive) all who helped them in its building, which by Your grace has risen high.
And forgive everyone who has dwelt in it, and whoever has leaned on it for good.
And make it full of light and mercy, without end.
And make its provision the purest of the lawful, in hardship and in ease, continuously.
And bestow on me in it a knowledge that benefits and elevation of renown, with a humble heart.
And grant me in it a supplication that is heard, with the contentment of a soul that is satisfied,
and a righteous wife who helps (me) toward the fear of Allah and piety, O Helper.
And spread forever the wing of Your veil over me, with all my family, O Eternal Refuge.
And pitch the pavilions of Your guarding over my house and all that is in it, entirely.
And bring all into the hidden depth of Your Unseen, and veil us from temptations,
from the wicked of creation and from calamities, from the jinn, Satan and trials.
And grant me long life with the fear of Allah and light, renunciation and scruple, through the ages.
And make my dwelling a dwelling of forgiveness, right direction, gnosis and good pleasure,
an abode of sincerity, truthfulness and scruple, an abode of the Sunna and a refuge from innovations.
And make it always a dwelling of learning, a place of reflection and understanding,
a dwelling of spiritual guidance and teaching, a dwelling of correction and of imparting understanding.
And make it a dwelling of going out from darknesses into light, and keep from it whoever has done wrong.
And make it always a dwelling of following the Sunna, not a dwelling of innovation.
And make it, O Lord, the most beloved dwelling in our land, to You and to al-Māḥī, the radiant.
And protect my house from depravity, wickedness and falsehood, through the ages.
And remove pestilence and all trials from it, and make its drink and its food wholesome.
And make our sacred precinct a safe precinct, and be the guarantor and surety of its keeping.
And gather good for it from the six directions, and spare it calamities.
Guard me from Satan, O Majestic, and my dwelling and all those I provide for.
O Allah, O Preserver, O Possessor of Command, O You Who surpass all creation together in dominion:
my soul and my religion, then my family and children, and my dwelling are a trust with You forever;
and so too my worldly life with my Hereafter: in both turn calamities away from me.
And turn the punishment of the Fire away from all those who have attached themselves to me among the children of this age,
and from all the brothers, whether kin in clay (blood) or in religion, and strangers.
So be a fortress for me and always, O Eternal Refuge, take charge of me and entrust me to no one.
And have mercy on all the Muslims forever, and bless and grant peace perpetually
upon Muḥammad, my means of approach to You, and grant me a good ending with You.
And extend the blessing to the Companions, besides his Family, and grant me the answering.
